description: Single major mistake (bible: overloading one final landing creates a queue). Plan A, but both coast skiffs are sent to the high landing. skiff:03 unloads the first four there and, its job done, stays docked on the landing's only berth; skiff:02, loaded with the last four coast residents, queues at the outer buoy for the rest of the operation. A vehicle still holds passengers at the end, so the operation fails although everyone else is safe.
